name: Acts of Faith
text: Keep a pool of Miracle dice. Gain one (roll a D6; the value is fixed) at the start of every turn and whenever one of your units with this ability is destroyed. Just before a roll for such a unit (Advance, Battle-shock, Charge, Damage, Hit, Save or Wound), spend a die in place of one die of that roll; it counts as unmodified. Once per unit per phase.

name: Lead the Righteous
text: While this model leads a unit, any hit roll for an attack made by a model in that unit may be re-rolled.

name: Null Rod
text: Models in the bearer's unit have a 4+ Feel No Pain save against mortal wounds and against damage from Psychic weapon attacks.

name: Sworn Protectors
text: While an ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER leads this unit, each attack that targets it suffers -1 to its wound roll.

name: Simulacrum Imperialis
text: At the end of your Command phase, if the model carrying this relic is alive, roll one D6 for each objective marker you control that any model of its unit is within range of. On a 4 or more, gain a Miracle die whose value is that roll.

name: Extremis Trigger Word
text: Each time this unit is selected to fight, you may speak the trigger word. If you do, until the end of the phase its arco-flails have 6 Attacks and gain [HAZARDOUS].

name: Angelic Ascent
text: In your Shooting phase, just after this unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit it may make a Normal move of up to 6 inches. If it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: Overseer of Redemption
text: While the Repentia Superior is alive, melee hit rolls for models in this unit may be re-rolled.

name: Overseer of Redemption (charge)
text: While the Repentia Superior is alive, if this unit made a Charge move this turn, its melee wound rolls may be re-rolled too.

name: Endless Suffering
text: This unit can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
